title: Console sign-in page cannot reach the mobile hand-off: a redirect to the auth API lands on 页面不存在
body:
Category: ① product defect with a named location and a reproduction.

Business reason: a user whose provider refuses embedded WebViews (Google among them) cannot sign in to the mobile app. objectstack-ai/mobile#148 opens the Console's sign-in page in the system auth session, and the Console has to finish by navigating to the hand-off #29766 shipped. Today it lands on 页面不存在, so the server half in 18.3.0 has no way to be reached.

Reader: `domain:ui`, one PR on `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`. objectstack-ai/mobile#148 waits on it.

Duplicate search: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack trustedAppSchemes` (5 hits, all closed, the spec and server halves) and `"one-time-token" OR "handoff" login redirect` (47 hits, none about this).

reach: measured on the released Console, `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0` with the scheme registered, 2026-11-03.

## Reproduction

1. Boot 18.3.0 with `trustedAppSchemes: ["ai.objectos.mobile"]` and open, signed out:
   `/_console/login?redirect=%2Fapi%2Fv1%2Fauth%2Fone-time-token%2Fhandoff%3Fredirect_uri%3Dai.objectos.mobile%253A%252F%252Fauth%252Fcallback%26code_challenge%3D<43 chars>%26code_challenge_method%3DS256`
2. Sign in.

**Expected:** the browser navigates to `/api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff?...`, which answers `302 ai.objectos.mobile://auth/callback?token=T`.

**Actual:** the address becomes `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff?...` and the page says 页面不存在.

## Cause

`LoginPage.tsx:266` and `:276` send every safe redirect through `withConsoleBase`, which treats it as a Console route: `window.location.assign(withConsoleBase(isSafeRedirect(redirect) ? redirect : '/'))`. The hand-off is an API route, outside the Console mount. Only a path starting with `/_` passes through unprefixed.

## What the page has to do

The hand-off's own rules (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/one-time-token-handoff.ts`, ruling A on #29714) set these:

1. **Reach the route, and nothing wider.** A `redirect` whose path is exactly the hand-off under the deployment's base path navigates there unprefixed. Every other redirect keeps today's behaviour. This must not become a general way out of the Console mount. Match on `AuthEndpointPaths.oneTimeTokenHandoff` rather than a copied string.
2. **Navigate by script from this page.** The route refuses `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`, and a redirect chain through the provider reports cross-site. So the provider's callback has to land on this page first (the social buttons' default `callbackURL` already does), and the page then calls `location.assign`, which reports `same-origin`. Passing the hand-off as `callbackURL` would be refused.
3. **Before the organization steps.** Today a user with several organizations goes to `/organizations` and the redirect is dropped; one with no active organization waits on `switchOrganization`. The hand-off carries the session and nothing else, and the app's WebView runs those steps after it. So this branch comes first.
4. **A session older than five minutes.** The route answers `401` as raw JSON to a session created more than five minutes ago. iOS uses an ephemeral auth session, so it arrives signed out. Android's Custom Tabs share Chrome's cookies and have no ephemeral mode through `expo-web-browser`, so a user who signed in to this server in Chrome last week arrives signed in, the page forwards at once, and they are stranded on JSON. On a hand-off redirect the page should show the sign-in form for such a session instead of forwarding, which needs the session's `createdAt`. How to get there (sign that browser session out first, or re-authenticate on top of it) is the card's design question, and it belongs in the PR body.

## Acceptance notes

- A unit test per rule above, including a redirect such as `/api/v1/data/x` staying a Console route as it is today.
- Browser check: the reproduction above ends in the `302`, for a password sign-in and for a provider sign-in.
- `RegisterPage.tsx:189` and `:197` have the same shape. A user who registers from the auth session has the same problem, if sign-up is reachable there; handle it or say why not.
- This is a session-transfer flow: the maintainer reviews and merges.

Blocks: objectstack-ai/mobile#148
